caption: A traffic light at a quiet crossing changes from red to green, and the red lamp goes dark as the green lamp lights.

sa.check: A traffic light at a crossing, showing red.
The crossing is quiet: little or no traffic.
The red goes dark as the green lights, not long before or after.

pc.expect: The red lamp goes dark and the green lamp lights at the same moment; only one lamp is lit at a time before and after.
pc.fail: The red and green lamps are both lit together for a stretch; or the red goes dark and the green stays dark to the end of the clip; or the green lights while the red stays lit to the end; or the amber lamp lights together with the green.

pc.expect: The signal head keeps its lamps in their fixed positions: red at top, amber in the middle, green at bottom, each staying where it is whether lit or dark.
pc.fail: A lamp changes place on the head; or a fourth lamp appears; or a lamp vanishes rather than going dark; or the green glow appears in the red lamp's position.

pc.expect: Once the green is lit it stays lit for the rest of the clip and the red stays dark.
pc.fail: The red comes back on while the green is still lit; or the green flickers; or the lamps swap back and forth; or the green fades slowly to dark.

pc.expect: The signal head and its pole stay still through the change; parked vehicles and street furniture do not move at the change.
pc.fail: The head swings or turns at the change; or the pole moves; or a parked car jumps forward at the change; or signs shift.

pc.expect: The signal head, pole and surroundings keep their shapes; nothing passes through anything.
pc.fail: The head changes shape or merges with the pole; or a vehicle passes through the pole; or the head duplicates; or the road surface changes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pole's colour, the head's housing and the crossing markings stay the same apart from the lamps.
pc.fail: The housing changes colour; or the road markings change; or the pole changes shape.

note: Vehicles moving off when the light turns green are driven and are not judged.
